scope: Correct an unsupported aggregate audiovisual permission claim after current own-site and linked video-portal conditions were inspected.

metadata.scope: Exact lower chamber; no Senate coverage or rights inferred.

official_media.finding: Video portal footer's info-site link redirects to the same current general notice. Download/clip help describes delivery mechanisms but establishes no superseding audiovisual republication licence.

epg.finding: Existing official public-sitting, open-data agenda ZIP and broadcast programme routes remain recorded in the catalogue. This rights review does not newly validate their freshness, mapping or parser coverage.

linking.finding: The current notice permits hyperlinks subject to its source-context restrictions.

embedding.finding: No separate applicable embed grant found in the directly linked video resources; do not extend document reproduction terms to multimedia.

direct_playback.finding: Research-only HLS remains disabled; no extracted playback grant or current technical certification established.

rebroadcast.finding: Multimedia reproduction requires prior agreement under the notice; no project agreement or superseding retransmission grant recorded.

copying_recording.finding: Offering full-debate or selected MP4 delivery does not settle independent copying/republication rights.

audiovisual_reuse.finding: The official-document conditional grant and the multimedia prior-agreement clause are distinct.

programme_data.finding: Official documents have integrity, source/author/link, free-distribution and noncommercial/nonadvertising conditions; exact agenda-dataset licensing still needs review.

catalogue_correction.basis: This catalogue bucket includes materially restricted uses requiring separate permission. It does not prohibit the expressly permitted official hyperlinks.

unresolved: A source-specific applicable multimedia agreement or grant remains unconfirmed.
Current-live, full room inventory, audible tracks and EPG coverage remain separate checks.
